summary: cisco.nxos deprecates automatic Jinja2 templating of nxos_config's src parameter (removed March 2028); use content with the template lookup.

answer_card.title: nxos_config src templating deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `cisco.nxos.nxos_config`, automatic Jinja2 processing of `src` is deprecated and removed in **March 2028**. Use `content` with the `ansible.builtin.template` lookup.
